independence_declaration.statement: I am qa-verifier. I did not author any analysis, register, agent definition, runner, guard, gate tooling, CI or delivery record in the reviewed scope. I wrote only QA tests and scripts under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/ and my own round-20 review files. I read no other round-20 review record. The real-repository checks ran on a clone taken at ce6d9b6, before any round-20 record existed, so no other round-20 verdict was visible to me.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate and the assignment before reviewing
checks_run.command: sha256sum docs/delivery/assignments/DG0/round-20/review-qa-verifier.md; git rev-parse HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0; git diff --name-only a23c4d4 ce6d9b6
checks_run.environment: /home/user/My-owns in the agent sandbox, node v22.22.2
checks_run.expected: Assignment sha256 0ee0a0c8...; HEAD equals a23c4d4 or only metadata-only commits follow it; candidate ID ef3ec3f2...
checks_run.actual: The assignment sha256 matches. HEAD is ce6d9b6 (freeze commit). The only files changed after a23c4d4 are round-20 assignments, the candidate manifest and stages.json, all excluded delivery metadata. candidate.mjs prints sha256:ef3ec3f205ffdac3609c6f100cfb9900afb72f0e5bb381fbc5409eb1a8a8ddaf (91 files).

checks_run.procedure: Step 1: run every required command in a disposable clone of the candidate commit, and reconcile/pipeline/candidate at HEAD
checks_run.command: tools/source/check_extraction.sh; node --test tools/gates/tests/*.test.mjs; node --test tools/agents/tests/*.test.mjs; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG0; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --pipeline; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --reconcile; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0
checks_run.environment: git clone of /home/user/My-owns at a23c4d4 under $TMPDIR (and at ce6d9b6 for reconcile), agent shell sandbox, no network, node v22.22.2
checks_run.expected: All exit 0; test suites all pass; working tree hashes to ef3ec3f2
checks_run.actual: check_extraction PASS (docx sha256 2584a352...548ad2, 165 + 423 blocks). Gate tests 55/55. Agent tests 39/39, including process-sandbox. The register is PASS at DG0, the pipeline is PASS (DG0 REVIEWING) and reconcile is PASS. At ce6d9b6 the frozen and working-tree candidates match (ef3ec3f2). candidate.mjs prints ef3ec3f2. All exit 0.

checks_run.procedure: Run tools/gates/prefreeze.sh DG0 in a fresh clone of the candidate commit
checks_run.command: git clone /home/user/My-owns $TMPDIR/pf20 && git checkout a23c4d4 && bash tools/gates/prefreeze.sh DG0
checks_run.environment: fresh clone under $TMPDIR, nested bubblewrap via tools/gates/sandbox-run.sh
checks_run.actual: 11/11 PASS, including the sandboxed test suites, the register equal to the merge output, the four analysis checks and 'working-tree candidate equals HEAD (sha256:ef3ec3f2...)'. exit 0 in 49.7 s.

checks_run.procedure: Step 2 (A24/A25): independent round-20 suite. It re-runs my 94-case round-9 A24/A25 suite: missing reviewer, reviewer who authored the scope, shared invocation, failed/blocked check, unresolved High, incomplete requirement, non-existent anchor, SOURCE row without a playbook block, coverage gaps, change after freeze, tampered manifest, metadata invariance, and more. It adds 12 new cases for D-036 that are not in tools/gates/tests: gate source_commit missing, a tree id, a blob id, abbreviated, upper-case, an off-branch commit with different content, an off-branch commit with the same content, a tag object; D-035 non-gate tolerance; metadata invariance
checks_run.environment: disposable git fixtures under $TMPDIR; candidate clone at a23c4d4; node v22.22.2
checks_run.expected: Controls clean. The r9 suite fails only in the known 5 cases (3 cwd controls, the superseded static QA7-N83, and QA5-N57, which is the D-035 non-gate tolerance by design). S1-S6 are rejected in current mode. N1: pruned non-gate round tolerated, present-but-different rejected. M1: metadata does not change the ID, content does
checks_run.actual: 12/12 pass. G0 control is 0 errors in both modes. G1: 94 cases, and exactly the expected 5 differ. S1 missing, S2 tree and S3 blob give 'gate source_commit ... is not a commit in this repository' in current mode. S4 abbreviated and S5 upper-case are rejected by the schema. S6 off-branch different content gives 'does not describe its source_commit'. N1 behaves as expected. M1: base = after-metadata = ef3ec3f2, and after a validator edit b9aa60b2. Probes: S7, an off-branch commit with the same content, is ACCEPTED locally in both modes and REJECTED in a --no-local clone (F-DG0-241). S8, a tag object id, is accepted everywhere (harmless).

checks_run.procedure: D-036 mutation check: the new unit test fails against the pre-fix validator and passes on the candidate
checks_run.command: git show 0a65201:tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs > tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs; node --test --test-name-pattern=D-036 tools/gates/tests/validator.test.mjs; git checkout -- tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs; (repeat)
checks_run.expected: not ok on pre-fix, ok on the candidate
checks_run.actual: Pre-fix: not ok 1 (no 'is not a commit' error). Candidate: ok 1. The clone is clean afterwards.

checks_run.procedure: D-036 on a copy of the REAL repository: pruned non-gate rounds tolerated; a drafted APPROVED gate with a non-existent source_commit (gate only; gate + manifest + stages copies) gets the D-036 error in current mode through the CLI, and the control with the real commit does not
checks_run.environment: --no-local clone of the repository at ce6d9b6 (101 commits) under $TMPDIR; validate.mjs --stage DG0 (current mode)
checks_run.expected: R1: no manifest error for absent round commits. R2: D-036 line absent in the control and present in both fake variants
checks_run.actual: R1: rounds 1-12 and 18 are absent from the clone, and checkReviewRounds reports only the 3 not-yet-written round-20 records. R2: control has no D-036 line. Both fake variants print 'candidate: gate source_commit 5a1e5a1e5a is not a commit in this repository'. RESULT PASS.

checks_run.procedure: Gate dry-run on the REAL history: draft a schema-valid APPROVED DG0 gate on the real frozen candidate and classify every validateGate error into 'clears when round 20 completes' vs permanent
checks_run.environment: --no-local clone of the repository at ce6d9b6 under $TMPDIR
checks_run.expected: Apart from the unfinished round 20 (records, pending findings, state), no errors: the candidate's validator can approve DG0 on the history it will be audited in
checks_run.actual: 263 errors. The permanent ones: 132 fix_revision ancestry errors (66 CLOSED_VERIFIED findings whose fix commit was pruned) and 63 verifier-run head_commit_at_start errors (pruned commits, absent in the local repository too), both F-DG0-242 (High). 2 record-less round-17/18 qa sidecars and 1 'dropped' F-DG0-238, F-DG0-243 (High). 6 verification-evidence files of round 19 never committed and 4 CLOSED_VERIFIED findings with a null or abbreviated fix_revision, F-DG0-244 (Medium). DG0 cannot pass with this candidate.

checks_run.procedure: Step 3: independent register integrity (own RFC 4180 parser). Checks: columns; no VERIFIED rows; IMPLEMENTED evidence paths exist; A01-A28 coverage; final_gate/increments consistency; counts per class, area and gate; both coverage matrices exactly complete (every block once, forward and reverse). Also checks that the register and analysis are unchanged since the round-19 candidate. Opened the D-036 evidence of REQ-DLV-023 (rules.mjs checkCandidate, validator.test.mjs)
checks_run.command: cd $TMPDIR/c20 && node <repo>/docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/tests/register-integrity.mjs .; git diff --stat 0a65201 a23c4d4 -- docs/analysis docs/delivery/requirements.csv ...

checks_run.actual: 412 rows (SOURCE 93 / ENGINEERING 131 / USER 188). Final gates: DG0 19, DG1 12, DG2 32, DG3 32, DG4 137, DG5 78, DG6 48, DG7 54. Status: IMPLEMENTED 19 (all the DG0 rows), SPECIFIED 393, no VERIFIED. All 28 scenarios are referenced. Coverage: playbook 165 blocks and master prompt 423 blocks, 0 reverse gaps. errors 0, RESULT PASS. The analysis, register, agents, agents.md, tools/agents and sources are unchanged since round 19. Only settings.json, decisions.md, threat-model.md, rules.mjs and validator.test.mjs changed.

checks_run.command: Write docs/source/QA-PROBE.txt; echo probe > docs/source/QA-PROBE.txt; touch tools/gates/QA-PROBE docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/domain/QA-PROBE docs/delivery/reviews/DG0/round-19/QA-PROBE

summary: FAIL for DG0 candidate ef3ec3f2 (a23c4d4). The D-036 repair is correct: F-DG0-240 is verified fixed and CLOSED_VERIFIED, and the D-035 non-gate tolerance still holds. All required commands, prefreeze (11/11), the A24/A25 regression suite with 12 new cases, register integrity, the agent load evidence, the live guard probe and feasibility pass. However, a dry-run gate on the real repository history shows that DG0 cannot be approved with this candidate. 195 validator errors come from pruned history: fix_revision and verifier head commits absent since the pre-round-12 truncation and the D-034 rewrite (F-DG0-242, High). The record-less round-17/18 qa sidecars that D-034 keeps are rejected, and F-DG0-238 counts as dropped (F-DG0-243, High). Metadata gaps: uncommitted round-19 evidence and abbreviated or missing fix_revision values (F-DG0-244, Medium). New Low: D-036 accepts an off-branch commit with the same content, which a fresh clone rejects (F-DG0-241, acceptable as an observation). None of these is a mandatory violation; the validator fails closed.
